description: Named on the direction. Not present.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Named on the old line. Not present. Not paid.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Had brought the parcel from the house, looked at the horses' feet, and went on to St Bride's.
name: Gilbert Shakespeare

description: Took the parcel and the letter, priced them, and watered the horses before any sorting.

description: Wrote the two payments under the old line.
name: William Shakespeare
